_bob.role: docs/GENERATION.md, the geometry family: the Hunyuan fallback and zero-submodule smoke test
_bob.purpose: Single-view image to a watertight mesh with no custom pack involved, so the Bob-side plumbing can be proved without ComfyUI-TRELLIS2.
deviations_from_source: BOB_* titles added on the templated nodes. BOB_3D_MODEL is meaningful HERE and only here: ImageOnlyCheckpointLoader does name a checkpoint file, where LoadTrellis2Models does not.
SaveGLB's filename_prefix moved from mesh/ComfyUI to bob_mesh, so a Bob run is identifiable in the output folder and Bob knows the stem it is looking for.

Nothing else. Latent 4096, 30 steps, cfg 5, euler + normal are the template's own 2.1 values; swap BOB_3D_MODEL to hunyuan3d-dit-v2_fp16 with latent 3072, 20 steps and cfg 8 for the faster 2.0 variant.
_bob.requires_pack: none, all four are ComfyUI core
_bob.notes: Watertight SDF-voxel output, so this graph structurally cannot make a leaf, and that was measured before the pack was pinned. It is the zero-install smoke test and the hard-surface fallback, not the primary route. SaveGLB is a core output node and reports its own filename, so this graph needs no Preview3D.
